```{r}
# LOO model-selection table for the substrate-use (Supplementary Table 1)
# or behavioral-response (Supplementary Table 2) candidate model sets.
# Rendered by scripts/render_supplementary_tables.R

library(loo)
library(knitr)
options(kableExtra.latex.load_packages = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)

root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_rstudio_project)

analysis <- params$analysis

loos <- readRDS(file.path(root, "data/processed", paste0("loo_list_", analysis, ".rds")))

# loo_compare() returns models sorted by elpd, with names in its `model` column
lc <- as.data.frame(loo_compare(loos))
mod_order <- lc$model

weights <- loo_model_weights(loos, method = "stacking")

# fixed-effect structure of each model (random intercept for individual
# is included in all models)
fixed_terms <- sapply(mod_order, function(m) {
  f <- readRDS(file.path(root, "data/processed", paste0("fits_", analysis), paste0(m, ".rds")))
  # multivariate behavior models share the same predictors across responses
  form <- if (!is.null(f$formula$forms)) f$formula$forms[[1]]$formula else f$formula$formula
  rhs <- deparse1(form[[3]])
  gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*\\(1 \\| [[:alpha:]]+\\)", "", rhs)
})

pretty_terms <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("mo\\(sampling_period\\)", "sampling period (mo)", x)
  x <- gsub("mo\\([Nn]umber_of_legs\\)", "number of legs (mo)", x)
  x <- gsub("field_season", "field season", x)
  x <- gsub("Treatment_food_substrate|food_substrate", "food substrate", x)
  x <- gsub("[Ss]ensory_leg_missing", "sensory leg missing", x)
  x <- gsub("leg_condition", "leg condition", x)
  x <- gsub(" \\* ", " $\\\\times$ ", x)
  x
}

tab <- data.frame(
  rank = seq_along(mod_order),
  model = gsub("_", "\\\\_", mod_order),
  terms = pretty_terms(fixed_terms),
  elpd_diff = sprintf("%.2f", lc$elpd_diff),
  se_diff = sprintf("%.2f", lc$se_diff),
  elpd_loo = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", lc$elpd_loo, lc$se_elpd_loo),
  p_loo = sprintf("%.1f", lc$p_loo),
  looic = sprintf("%.1f", lc$looic),
  weight = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(weights[mod_order])),
  row.names = NULL
)

max_k <- max(sapply(loos, function(x) max(x$diagnostics$pareto_k)))
n_obs <- nrow(loos[[1]]$pointwise)

desc <- switch(
  analysis,
  substrate = paste(
    "of the", length(loos), "candidate Bayesian categorical mixed models of substrate use",
    "(rock, sand or other substrate) in Opiliones."
  ),
  behavior = paste(
    "of the", length(loos), "candidate Bayesian multivariate Bernoulli mixed models of behavioral",
    "responses (flee, escape, bobbing, chemical release and freeze) to an aversive stimulus in Opiliones."
  )
)

fit_desc <- switch(
  analysis,
  substrate = "categorical family",
  behavior = "Bernoulli family with logit link for each of the five behaviors, residual correlations not modeled; predictors were identical across behaviors"
)
```

```{r}
kbl(
  tab,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  escape = FALSE,
  align = c("r", "l", "p{9.5cm}", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  col.names = c(
    "Rank", "Model", "Fixed effects",
    "$\\Delta$elpd", "SE $\\Delta$elpd",
    "elpd\\textsubscript{loo} (SE)", "p\\textsubscript{loo}",
    "LOOIC", "Stacking weight"
  ),
  caption = paste0(
    "\\textbf{Supplementary Table ", params$table_no, ".} ",
    "Approximate leave-one-out cross-validation (PSIS-LOO) comparison ", desc,
    " Models are ranked by expected log pointwise predictive density (elpd\\textsubscript{loo})."
  )
) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 9) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "$\\\\Delta$elpd: difference in elpd\\\\textsubscript{loo} relative to the top-ranked model; ",
      "SE $\\\\Delta$elpd: standard error of that difference; ",
      "p\\\\textsubscript{loo}: effective number of parameters; LOOIC = $-2 \\\\times$ elpd\\\\textsubscript{loo}. ",
      "Stacking weights were computed with loo::loo\\\\_model\\\\_weights(method = \"stacking\"). ",
      "All models include a random intercept for individual and were fitted with brms (", fit_desc,
      "; 4 chains, 4,000 iterations each). ",
      "(mo) denotes monotonic effects. ",
      "N = ", format(n_obs, big.mark = ","), " observations. ",
      "All Pareto $k$ values were $<$ 0.7 (maximum = ", sprintf("%.2f", max_k), ")."
    ),
    threeparttable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    general_title = "Note."
  )
```
